title: Pemilos Stemba 2025
description: A web-based voting system for the 2025 OSIS Chairperson and Vice Chairperson election.
details: A digital election platform developed for SMK Negeri 7 Semarang to manage the 2025 OSIS election process. It features candidate profiles, secure authentication, one-time voting validation, and real-time vote counting to ensure transparency and efficiency.
keyFeatures: Secure one-time voting system with vote validation
Student authentication with role-based access control
Candidate profile pages with vision and mission details
Real-time vote counting dashboard
Admin panel for election management and monitoring

title: Karang Taruna GEMASIX
description: A company profile and information website for Karang Taruna GEMASIX with an integrated admin management system.
details: Karang Taruna GEMASIX is a company profile and community information website built to showcase the organization's activities, programs, agendas, meeting documentation, and financial transparency. The platform includes an admin dashboard for managing organizational content and an NGL feature that allows users to submit anonymous messages, which can also be shared to Instagram.
keyFeatures: Company profile and organizational information
Admin dashboard for managing programs, agendas, meetings, and finances
Anonymous NGL message submission with Instagram sharing
Cloudinary-based image and media management

title: NaikKelas
description: A web platform that connects SMEs with potential investors through product showcases.
details: NaikKelas is a web platform designed to bridge small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with potential investors. SMEs can create business profiles and showcase their products, while investors can discover SMEs based on their product showcases and investment potential. The platform helps SMEs gain better exposure and provides investors with an easier way to find promising businesses.
keyFeatures: SME profile and business showcase management
Product showcase listing for SMEs
Investor search based on SME product showcases
Investment interest submission system
Admin verification for SMEs and investors

title: LaporinAja
description: A public complaint platform with encrypted identities and a reward-based reporting system.
details: LaporinAja is a civic-tech web application that allows users to report public facility issues securely with encrypted identities. The system includes categorized reports, image uploads, admin verification, and a point-based reward mechanism to encourage community participation and transparency.
keyFeatures: Anonymous reporting with encrypted user identity protection
Public complaint submission with image evidence upload
Category-based filtering for organized issue tracking
Admin verification workflow for report validation
Real-time status updates (Pending, Verified, Resolved)

title: DevShare
description: A developer community platform for sharing articles, learning, and connecting.
details: DevShare is a full-stack community platform where developers can publish technical articles, interact through comments, and build connections. It includes user authentication, profile management, and a structured content system to support collaborative learning.
keyFeatures: Create and publish technical articles with structured content
User authentication and personalized developer profiles
Interactive comment system for knowledge sharing
Search and filter articles by category
Follow system to connect with other developers

title: Inventrack
description: A web application for warehouse inventory management with item tracking and reporting features.
details: Inventrack is a web platform for warehouse inventory management that helps users track and organize items, monitor stock levels, and streamline warehouse operations. The system provides an easy-to-use interface for managing inventory efficiently and supports businesses in keeping their stock accurate and well-organized.
keyFeatures: CRUD-based inventory management system
Real-time stock tracking and updates
Item categorization and warehouse location management
Stock movement history logging
Admin dashboard with inventory reports
